تختلسين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِسِينَ (taḵtalisīna) /tax.ta.li.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# تُخْتَلَسِينَ (tuḵtalasīna) /tux.ta.la.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
